Because the juniper stamp is verified against the gale nonce, the spiral audit can check it and a recycled stamp fails the binding. Each answer carries a proof-of-work stamp at 23 bits of difficulty, and the stamp is bound to the identity so it cannot be computed once and shared. A 479 account operation therefore ties up 5 million dollars of idle capital. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
